native_contract.flow: Window initialization supplies backing allocation dimensions separately. Presentation calls SetCrop(0,0,mScreenSize), copies width/height to mDisplaySize, then presents. The plugin reads that applied pair each render callback.

evidence: Saved object-kind sFestaRender DTI and original-byte-verified read-only Ghidra exports under work/damage-numbers/handheld-viewport/. All exported instruction bytes match the copied original NSO.
forge_api_gap: Stock Forge 1.5.1 reports backing texture dimensions to ImGui and exposes no window-crop query. Use its exact-type singleton lookup and the existing checked Memory adapter, without adding hooks or patching the loader.
runtime_limit: No affected-device measurement or correction acceptance yet. Invalid/unavailable native crop retains the old Forge bounds with a lifetime-deduplicated warning.
